name: Safer Textiles
old_description: Founded in 1975, Safer Textiles is a leading player within the textile industry. The company has a track record of innovation through the introduction of new processes and finishes, as well as investments in cutting edge technology.
about:
Safer Textiles was founded in 1975 by Albert Safer in Newark, New Jersey. The privately owned company operates a 180,000-square-foot facility on 5.7 acres in an Urban Enterprise Zone and employs over 125 people.

The mill is vertically integrated, handling knitting, dyeing, finishing, and coating under one roof. Its knitting department produces interlocks, jacquards, jerseys, piques, pontes, and specialty knits from a wide range of yarns. The dye house runs 25-plus modern computer-controlled machines — jets, soft flows, jigs, and atmospheric beams — with lot capacities up to 4,000 pounds and a Datacolor 800 spectrophotometer for color consistency. Finishing includes preparation (desizing, bleaching, scouring), surface treatments (napping, sueding, sanding), and chemical finishes such as flame retardant, moisture management, antimicrobial, and durable water/oil repellent. Coating uses a knife-blade process to apply water-based polyurethane on a 90-foot, 10-zone thermal range.

Safer Textiles serves apparel, medical PPE (masks, gowns meeting Levels 1–3), team sports (antimicrobial, wicking, UV-treated uniforms), military (DOD-spec fabrics), industrial (coated nylon for water/oil repellency), home furnishings, and novelty markets.

The company emphasizes industry-leading turnaround times, the ability to execute high-volume orders, and a fully stocked warehouse with its own trucking network and global carriers to deliver on time. Its integrated model allows a fabric to move from raw yarn to finished product without leaving the facility, supported by ongoing R&D investment.
